_comment: Canonical-bytes test vectors for #1051 hash-chain history. Each vector records the input event (without hash field), the canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes, and the expected SHA-256 hex. Two implementations that agree on sortKeysDeep + JSON.stringify(no-space) must produce these hashes.

spec.key_sort: UTF-16 code unit order (JavaScript Array.prototype.sort default)
spec.float_policy: timestamps must be ISO-8601 strings; a float in a chained event is a spec violation

vectors.name: cjk-content
vectors.description: Event with CJK (Japanese) content in data.statement. Validates that non-ASCII characters are preserved verbatim in canonical bytes and hash correctly.

vectors.name: nested-data
vectors.description: Event with nested objects and arrays in data. Validates that sortKeysDeep recurses into nested objects (nested.count < nested.meta < nested.tags by UTF-16 order), and that the prev field (predecessor hash from cjk-content) is included in canonical bytes.
